points.point: Does Blotato shorten long URLs automatically
points.sentence: I don't have automatic link shortening as a feature in Blotato yet.

points.point: X (Twitter) as the platform where links use up characters
points.sentence: short-text platforms like Twitter, Threads, or Bluesky, I recommend using a free link shortener, such as Bitly or Shorturl.

verdict.reason: The entry directly answers that Blotato has no automatic link shortening and names Twitter (X's former name) among short-text platforms where a free shortener is recommended.
